monitoring_rules.name: Expired JWT Usage Attempt
monitoring_rules.trigger: JWT exp claim < now() AND endpoint returns 2xx
monitoring_rules.query: SELECT * FROM auth_logs WHERE token_exp < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND http_status = 200

monitoring_rules.name: Login Rate Anomaly — Possible Credential Stuffing
monitoring_rules.trigger: Failed login attempts > 10 per IP per minute
monitoring_rules.query: SELECT ip, COUNT(*) FROM auth_logs WHERE status='failed' AND ts > NOW()-60s GROUP BY ip HAVING COUNT(*) > 10

monitoring_rules.name: IDOR Enumeration Pattern
monitoring_rules.trigger: User accessing >20 resources with sequential IDs not in their ownership set

monitoring_rules.name: Smart Contract Reentrancy Detection
monitoring_rules.trigger: Recursive call depth > 1 on withdrawal/transfer functions
monitoring_rules.on_chain_monitor: event ReentrancyAttempt(address indexed caller, uint256 depth)

monitoring_rules.name: Token Supply Anomaly
monitoring_rules.trigger: totalSupply > MAX_SUPPLY OR single-block mint > per_block_cap

monitoring_rules.name: Privilege Escalation Attempt
monitoring_rules.trigger: role field present in PATCH /users/me body

monitoring_rules.name: SSRF Outbound Request to Private Range
monitoring_rules.trigger: Outbound HTTP from app server to RFC1918 (10.x, 172.16.x, 192.168.x) or 169.254.x.x

monitoring_rules.name: Suspicious File Upload Type
monitoring_rules.trigger: File upload with magic bytes matching executable, script, or archive

monitoring_rules.name: Large Financial Transaction Anomaly
monitoring_rules.trigger: Single transaction > $10,000 OR velocity > $50,000 in 24h for non-verified account

monitoring_rules.name: Admin Action Without MFA
monitoring_rules.trigger: Admin-scoped API call with token lacking mfa_verified=true claim

monitoring_rules.name: Blockchain Double-Spend Attempt
monitoring_rules.trigger: Two transfers from same account within same block with identical nonce

monitoring_rules.name: Secret Pattern in Application Logs
monitoring_rules.trigger: Log line matches pattern: (api_key|secret|password|token|private_key)\s*[=:]\s*[A-Za-z0-9+/]{20,}

monitoring_rules.name: SQL Error in HTTP Response
monitoring_rules.trigger: HTTP response body contains SQL error message patterns

monitoring_rules.name: Account Takeover Signal — Geo Anomaly
monitoring_rules.trigger: Same account authenticated from 2+ countries within 30 minutes

monitoring_rules.name: API Shadow Endpoint Detection
monitoring_rules.trigger: HTTP request to path not in registered API schema returning 200

monitoring_rules.name: Delivery Address Tamper Attempt
monitoring_rules.trigger: PATCH /delivery/addresses/{id} where address.user_id != jwt.user_id

monitoring_rules.name: Mobile APK Integrity Check Failure
monitoring_rules.trigger: App checksum on API request header does not match known-good signed build hash

monitoring_rules.name: Audit Log Tamper Detection
monitoring_rules.trigger: Audit log hash chain broken — entry hash != SHA256(prev_hash + entry_data)

monitoring_rules.name: Mass Data Export Anomaly
monitoring_rules.trigger: Single user downloads >1000 records via API within 10 minutes

monitoring_rules.name: CVE in Active Dependency
monitoring_rules.trigger: Dependency scan identifies package with CVSS >= 7.0 in use
monitoring_rules.schedule: Every CI/CD pipeline run + daily scheduled scan
